However, human clinical evidence proving that DHM prevents hangovers or speeds up alcohol clearance is still limited.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdwHEIkXXhqYwrPCYO1PkGfFde4JlWb6wtzCE3nstX3o0ojpO5c-CdSdr09uILUJpg-qpktpPOgSp1u2rVaHoXlpBx5AGDi2NLa90e5wVMClD7vuU18iqF7VBEjq8G4uN0ESThJlQhf0vGDyQYBhcJN5d1VNjT4av)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESagHEIkXX2CbeD-9qxdvBgFOfcwF7qG0ZdkRxEJW6MJLQdBACVdHaQVSB0TajuV1krSM4qYA61q3qetTfOjkn0P8K6Z0hHGl3UMowhTv6J9KQ1MOhshGRvo4r3Q9fkn9P7knkUrzvpqnD814)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESsgEBxCJF13624AeyWqOs6L-UOH1wBlG7SVtKA-gCny_UZm6MCw0pwCMRvDttypc1fA70jBEUmEBLmGhXXH0H8MoIl4_HK956cva-YRmSaXQP56J_L3dNeDfwYrRRN443BRfRoraNEqBPPbfZoWjrYaLlbXjEsEnRguKdAc-A7CUPW3zLs4n5aqj8U7QIBexqG_1rlZZkDvv3sbkc_4CgtQJ5VyeQcZbCUYg9g4M2rPmMv99E)

### Typical Timing and Dosing

- **Timing:** Many guides and supplement labels suggest taking DHM **30 to 60 minutes before** your first drink, **during** drinking, or **right after** drinking (or before bed). Always follow the specific instructions on your product label.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZAHEIkXXXXIFaOKtJGR320yzntv3U442OtjJuah22_YA0tdGc8SQNll9ZMaC4BeBAGrCPra5mx1QvFORGS2TEaGU2KBxwMxHjQrrZWj6OyF3L9u4QaoCZmqIxg_FH_CS9EM124M)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfQHEIkXXEkrU3U3sBIkXouvAN4hKTt7wo7ZfQWF0M-cD6eJltJygiG9MRu4r1H-W0PfAxTpmAix8fLlfyI_6VZFvyQzfEji6JCDaUOqxsBIlXmFB7HTibvxi13WOtDKV0uWmWLLm009RPxBEJTGW__b5pCqJMOuHOVXyfNsO)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESagHEIkXX2CbeD-9qxdvBgFOfcwF7qG0ZdkRxEJW6MJLQdBACVdHaQVSB0TajuV1krSM4qYA61q3qetTfOjkn0P8K6Z0hHGl3UMowhTv6J9KQ1MOhshGRvo4r3Q9fkn9P7knkUrzvpqnD814)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXN60Ssaz7ltpILS5YGMxwvY6OxDVFZzpBGZHPGMi_o0Brn0TpO55_T5I0URCRX7uak--DKbu1X6MIjlYTIzSmRBoHAJ1JPjePaEZArgPJuxTh04040zdqWuexb4fICOKCt_baSllTJQ)[[5]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShgEBxCJF17eJ1moi2h9Oo5EWd5Foa62ka6c2Yz4iQeimItX0AkXaASqOeuSoxYwMcVVKk5TkLGUfA-q2riEI0SdrWbRDVfDVwvqP_AgU6c36lUIlWTEImqrduLBpnhHpWfNKOlOHgsYPP4rDaAkvwCpi27VCkHr9IavO1Q2-ClMg3RuTPiLRxA)
- **Amount:** Common single-session amounts fall between **300 mg and 600 mg** , with some supplement guides scaling by body weight (such as 300 mg for smaller adults up to 500–600 mg for heavier adults). Keep total intake under **1,000 mg daily**.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESsgEBxCJF13624AeyWqOs6L-UOH1wBlG7SVtKA-gCny_UZm6MCw0pwCMRvDttypc1fA70jBEUmEBLmGhXXH0H8MoIl4_HK956cva-YRmSaXQP56J_L3dNeDfwYrRRN443BRfRoraNEqBPPbfZoWjrYaLlbXjEsEnRguKdAc-A7CUPW3zLs4n5aqj8U7QIBexqG_1rlZZkDvv3sbkc_4CgtQJ5VyeQcZbCUYg9g4M2rPmMv99E)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESagHEIkXX2CbeD-9qxdvBgFOfcwF7qG0ZdkRxEJW6MJLQdBACVdHaQVSB0TajuV1krSM4qYA61q3qetTfOjkn0P8K6Z0hHGl3UMowhTv6J9KQ1MOhshGRvo4r3Q9fkn9P7knkUrzvpqnD814)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeQHEIkXXtad2s48lj4p1g-KholLFXmBnt1pQOWJP0tfBg-EsCTXXmEppaicmdFjzpN_8qH7B6FIWEzdN_9yf9ED9-hsVb8rPBkI2lZ5h808YaC2GwDp6fmC-upwO_8N2Wqp6Fprs_LumOlsem0LnBdKpa9eEu9rJ1BQ)

### Basic Hangover Habits

- **Pair with basics:** DHM does not replace eating a meal beforehand, drinking water alongside alcohol, pacing drinks, or getting enough sleep. You can also see [More Labs](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfQHEIkXXEkrU3U3sBIkXouvAN4hKTt7wo7ZfQWF0M-cD6eJltJygiG9MRu4r1H-W0PfAxTpmAix8fLlfyI_6VZFvyQzfEji6JCDaUOqxsBIlXmFB7HTibvxi13WOtDKV0uWmWLLm009RPxBEJTGW__b5pCqJMOuHOVXyfNsO) for a routine combining DHM supplement timing with food, hydration, and rest.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfQHEIkXXEkrU3U3sBIkXouvAN4hKTt7wo7ZfQWF0M-cD6eJltJygiG9MRu4r1H-W0PfAxTpmAix8fLlfyI_6VZFvyQzfEji6JCDaUOqxsBIlXmFB7HTibvxi13WOtDKV0uWmWLLm009RPxBEJTGW__b5pCqJMOuHOVXyfNsO)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShgEBxCJF17eJ1moi2h9Oo5EWd5Foa62ka6c2Yz4iQeimItX0AkXaASqOeuSoxYwMcVVKk5TkLGUfA-q2riEI0SdrWbRDVfDVwvqP_AgU6c36lUIlWTEImqrduLBpnhHpWfNKOlOHgsYPP4rDaAkvwCpi27VCkHr9IavO1Q2-ClMg3RuTPiLRxA)
- **Do not rely on it for sobriety:** DHM is not proven to lower blood alcohol concentration (BAC) or make you safe to drive. Only time lowers BAC.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdwHEIkXXhqYwrPCYO1PkGfFde4JlWb6wtzCE3nstX3o0ojpO5c-CdSdr09uILUJpg-qpktpPOgSp1u2rVaHoXlpBx5AGDi2NLa90e5wVMClD7vuU18iqF7VBEjq8G4uN0ESThJlQhf0vGDyQYBhcJN5d1VNjT4av)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZAHEIkXXXXIFaOKtJGR320yzntv3U442OtjJuah22_YA0tdGc8SQNll9ZMaC4BeBAGrCPra5mx1QvFORGS2TEaGU2KBxwMxHjQrrZWj6OyF3L9u4QaoCZmqIxg_FH_CS9EM124M)

### Safety and Interactions

- **Limited human data:** Long-term daily safety and effectiveness in humans are not well established, and supplements are not required to prove efficacy before sale.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdwHEIkXXhqYwrPCYO1PkGfFde4JlWb6wtzCE3nstX3o0ojpO5c-CdSdr09uILUJpg-qpktpPOgSp1u2rVaHoXlpBx5AGDi2NLa90e5wVMClD7vuU18iqF7VBEjq8G4uN0ESThJlQhf0vGDyQYBhcJN5d1VNjT4av)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESsgEBxCJF13624AeyWqOs6L-UOH1wBlG7SVtKA-gCny_UZm6MCw0pwCMRvDttypc1fA70jBEUmEBLmGhXXH0H8MoIl4_HK956cva-YRmSaXQP56J_L3dNeDfwYrRRN443BRfRoraNEqBPPbfZoWjrYaLlbXjEsEnRguKdAc-A7CUPW3zLs4n5aqj8U7QIBexqG_1rlZZkDvv3sbkc_4CgtQJ5VyeQcZbCUYg9g4M2rPmMv99E)
- **Medication interactions:** Laboratory research suggests DHM may affect liver enzymes (such as CYP3A4, CYP2E1, and CYP2D6) and interact with sedatives, anti-anxiety medications, or other drugs. Check with a doctor or pharmacist before taking it if you take regular medications or have underlying health conditions.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdwHEIkXXhqYwrPCYO1PkGfFde4JlWb6wtzCE3nstX3o0ojpO5c-CdSdr09uILUJpg-qpktpPOgSp1u2rVaHoXlpBx5AGDi2NLa90e5wVMClD7vuU18iqF7VBEjq8G4uN0ESThJlQhf0vGDyQYBhcJN5d1VNjT4av)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESsgEBxCJF13624AeyWqOs6L-UOH1wBlG7SVtKA-gCny_UZm6MCw0pwCMRvDttypc1fA70jBEUmEBLmGhXXH0H8MoIl4_HK956cva-YRmSaXQP56J_L3dNeDfwYrRRN443BRfRoraNEqBPPbfZoWjrYaLlbXjEsEnRguKdAc-A7CUPW3zLs4n5aqj8U7QIBexqG_1rlZZkDvv3sbkc_4CgtQJ5VyeQcZbCUYg9g4M2rPmMv99E)
